title: AnalyticsChatCoworkUnifiedChatMetrics

connectors_used_count.title: Connectors Used Count
connectors_used_count.description: Same measure as `chat_metrics.connectors_used_count`, for activity recorded while members had Chat and Cowork unified turned on.

distinct_artifacts_created_count.title: Distinct Artifacts Created Count
distinct_artifacts_created_count.description: Same measure as `chat_metrics.distinct_artifacts_created_count`, for activity recorded while members had Chat and Cowork unified turned on. Exact in date-range mode: a creation belongs to exactly one day, so the per-day counts never overlap and their sum over the window is the exact count of distinct creations in it.

distinct_connectors_used_count.title: Distinct Connectors Used Count
distinct_connectors_used_count.description: Same measure as `chat_metrics.distinct_connectors_used_count`, for activity recorded while members had Chat and Cowork unified turned on. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

distinct_conversation_count.title: Distinct Conversation Count
distinct_conversation_count.description: Same measure as `chat_metrics.distinct_conversation_count`, for activity recorded while members had Chat and Cowork unified turned on. distinct_files_uploaded_count.title: Distinct Files Uploaded Count
distinct_files_uploaded_count.description: Same measure as `chat_metrics.distinct_files_uploaded_count`, for activity recorded while members had Chat and Cowork unified turned on. It counts uploaded files as well as files Claude created and images returned by Claude's tools, such as screenshots. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.
